description: This file contains the class `Currency` which is a controller for managing localization currencies in the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for listing currencies, displaying forms for editing/adding currencies, saving changes, deleting currencies, and retrieving currency data. The class extends the base controller and interacts with models, views, and URL helpers to facilitate currency management within the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing localization currencies in the OpenCart admin panel. Handles listing, form display, save, delete, and data retrieval operations related to currencies.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the currency listing page. Loads language, sets page title, manages sorting and paging URLs, prepares data, and renders the currency list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list currencies, loads language, and outputs the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of currencies based on sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters, then renders the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Alias method to refresh the currency list into the response output.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a currency. Loads existing currency data if editing, or initializes defaults for new entries.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the currency data submitted via the form, either inserting a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected currencies based on provided currency IDs.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves and outputs data for a specific currency, used for editing purposes.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the submitted form data for required fields, permissions, and data integrity before saving.

methods.name: validateDelete
methods.description: Validates if selected currencies can be deleted, typically checking user permissions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the currency data, loads language, gathers various status and count information related to currencies, stores, and orders, and updates the currency list accordingly.
